name: Traco Packaging - A Division of Traco Manufacturing, Inc.
old_description: Traco packaging professionals can assist you with the right shrink film and labels to meet all of your company’s packaging challenges. Trusted by the most iconic brands as well as new start-ups and private label brands. You too can trust Traco, your shrink-sleeve label manufacturer.
about:
Traco Packaging, a division of Traco Manufacturing, Inc., has operated from Orem, Utah since its founding in 1985. The company began as a packaging specialist focused on shrink-sleeve labels and has expanded its capabilities over nearly four decades.

Today Traco produces a range of packaging products including shrink sleeves, pressure-sensitive labels, stand-up pouches, three-side-seal pouches, roll stock, PVC shrink bands, shrink bags, and multi-pack bundling. Production runs on a mix of flexographic and digital presses: a Uteco Onyx XS 36-inch flexographic press, several HP Indigo digital presses (200K, 25K, 6600, 6900), a Gidue Master M5 630 9K 26-inch press, and a Nilpeter FA Line 17-inch flexographic press. The company also supplies label applicators and packaging equipment to help customers fill, pack, and ship.

Traco serves brand owners across the consumer packaged goods spectrum, from established national brands to start-ups and private-label companies. Its customers use the packaging for products that require high-quality graphics, tamper evidence, and shelf appeal.

The company emphasizes its equipment depth and experienced team as a way to deliver consistent print quality without delays. It highlights fast turnaround on short runs, variable data and security ink capabilities, and the ability to handle both long and short production runs on the same platform.
